glasses_dana: Previous notes suggested bathroom_shelf_ba1 for early morning, but today at 09:22 it was at coffee_table_l1. This confirms the "bathroom hub" pattern is unreliable for late morning. Check coffee_table_l1 for mid-day (09:00-15:00) and nightstand_b1 for late night (post-22:00). Do not default to bathroom for daytime queries.

water_bottle_dana: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for afternoon, but today at 19:54 it was at kitchen_table_k1. This indicates the bottle moves to the kitchen in the evening. Check coffee_table_l1 for mid-day (10:00-15:00) and kitchen_table_k1 for evening (post-18:00). The "living room hub" pattern does not apply to evening hours.

mug_dana: Previous notes assumed desk_o1 or cupboard_k1 during work hours, but today it was at coffee_table_l1 at 09:03 and 11:14. This contradicts the "stays at office/kitchen" pattern. The mug is consistently in the living room during the day. Check coffee_table_l1 for all daytime locations (09:00-18:00).

book_dana: Previous notes suggested side_table_l1 for early morning, but today at 08:57 it was at coffee_table_l1. Combined with today’s 20:43 finding (couch_l1), the book is in the living room all day. Check coffee_table_l1 for mid-day (09:00-15:00) and couch_l1 for evening (post-18:00). The "side table" location is incorrect for morning.

glass_dana: Previous notes suggested counter_k1 for afternoon, but today at 22:19 it was at nightstand_b1. This confirms the late-night location is the bedroom. Check nightstand_b1 for late night locations.

General Pattern: The "coffee_table_l1 as central hub" heuristic is the most reliable daytime location for Dana’s personal items (glasses, mugs, books, water bottles) between 09:00 and 15:00. Avoid guessing side tables, cupboards, or bathrooms for these items during this window. Evening locations shift to the kitchen (bottles) or couch (books).
